content.text: A register of legal entities, modelled on the CDM

type: each record carries a required name and optional identifiers (LEI, BIC, MIC, RED ID, country code, other). It serves any screen or process that needs to pick a legal entity — counterparties, agreements, obligors — and gives the firm one place to keep entity identifiers instead of free-text duplicates. Records carry a draft/active/retired lifecycle so a retired entity can be kept for history without being selectable for new business.
entity (name, status) with an embedded list of
rows (identifier + identifier type); uniqueness of the LEI across the register; the draft/active/retired lifecycle; the standard search screen and edit form.
OUT (non-goals): natural persons and the wider

model; relationships between entities (parents, branches); links from trades, agreements or collateral to a legal entity; external registry validation (e.g. live LEI lookup against GLEIF) — the LEI is stored and format-checked, not verified against the registry.
None — the bean's standard screens cover create/edit/browse; no multi-step journey is in scope.
R1: WHEN a legal entity is retired, the system SHALL keep the record and its identifiers unchanged and available for history. (Retirement is a status change, not a delete.)

R2: WHEN a legal entity is retired, the system SHALL exclude it from selection for new business. [ASSUMED: 'new business' means any future record creation that references a legal entity; existing references are untouched.]

cells.text: choice(BIC, LEI, MIC, REDID, COUNTRY_CODE, OTHER)

content.text: P1: at most one identifier of type LEI exists across the whole register — two legal entities never share an LEI, and one entity never carries two.
P2: a LEI-typed identifier is 20 alphanumeric characters (ISO 17442). [ASSUMED: format applies only to identifiers whose type is LEI.]
field is this spec's addition (CDM carries no lifecycle).

The bean's standard search screen and edit form. On the edit form, the identifier list should read as a simple add/remove list of rows (type + value), with the LEI row visibly marked so the 20-character rule is discoverable.
Considered, none apply: authorization (any signed-in user, the platform's default), performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.

A1 (verifies P1): WHEN a second legal entity is saved with an LEI identical to one already on the register, the system SHALL reject the save; and WHEN one entity is given two LEI-typed identifiers, the system SHALL reject it.

A2 (verifies P2): WHEN a LEI-typed identifier is saved with a value that is not exactly 20 alphanumeric characters, the system SHALL reject the save; WHEN a BIC-typed or other-typed identifier of any length is saved, the system SHALL accept it.
A3 (verifies R1): WHEN a legal entity is retired, the system SHALL keep the record and its identifiers readable and unchanged.
A4 (verifies R2): WHEN a retired legal entity is offered as a choice for a new reference, the system SHALL not offer it.
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.

LegalEntity - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
LegalEntity - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

LegalEntity - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
LegalEntity.status - validation.rule (persistence): default(draft) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test

EntityIdentifier - embeddedBean (bean): A bean another bean embeds: its class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry and its tests - a plain bean with NO persistence descriptor, so no migration, no table and no sheet; it lives inside the row of the bean that embeds it, and its descriptor is authored at spec time as its entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).

EntityIdentifier - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
None — the author settled shape, lifecycle and LEI strictness on the scope form; the remaining defaults are recorded as [ASSUMED] markers.
